phases.name: mating
phases.note: Rut lasts about 3 weeks at the end of the rainy season (Wikipedia). The checked sources give no month window for ZA, so the phase is not dated.

vocalizations.description: Territorial males bellow and grunt loudly during territorial displays, sounding like 'ga-noo'.

external.note: GBIF usageKey 2441105 (species rank, accepted, matched 2026-10-31) and iNaturalist taxon 42280 (species, active) agree; Wikidata P846 and P3151 carry the same identifiers.

common_names.note: Wikipedia: 'The blue wildebeest, also called the common wildebeest...'. The issue and iNaturalist use common wildebeest.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 = least concern (Q211005); Wikipedia infobox IUCN 3.1 LC.

range.note: Native: Wikipedia 'native to Angola, Botswana, Eswatini, Kenya, Mozambique, South Africa, Tanzania, Zambia, and Zimbabwe'. Introduced: Namibia, 'successfully reintroduced in Namibia' (treated as introduced, not native). Malawi omitted (extinct there).

traits.body_plan.note: Mammal, quadruped bovid; the Wikipedia infobox places it in Mammalia, Artiodactyla, Bovidae.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Gallop: Wikipedia 'extremely agile... can run at speeds up to 80 km/h'. Walk: Wikipedia Serengeti activity budget, 12% of time moving, mostly walking. No Trot mode: no checked source describes trotting, so it is omitted.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Authored: endotherm, as for mammals. Not drawn from a source in this pass.

traits.skin.note: Authored: mammal default, fur. Not stated in the checked sources. Judgement.

traits.nest_type.note: Authored: 'None'. Calves are dropped in the open and not nested.

traits.mass_kg.note: Wikipedia: 'Males typically weigh 165 to 290 kg ... females weigh 140 to 260 kg'. Midpoints: male 227.5 kg, female 200 kg; mean of the two midpoints = 213.75 kg. Derived from the source's explicitly typical ranges, not from a maximum or captive value.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Lower bound of the female typical range (140 kg) and upper bound of the male typical range (290 kg), per Wikipedia's 'typically weigh' sentence.

traits.length_m.note: Nose to tail tip, derived: head-and-body length 1.7-2.4 m (midpoint 2.05 m) plus tail length 60-100 cm (midpoint 0.80 m) = 2.85 m. ADW's 'Average length 123 cm' (NC) is a different measurement and is not used. Low confidence because the two sources do not agree on the measurement.

traits.shoulder_height_m.note: Midpoint of Wikipedia 'average height of the species is 1.15-1.45 m'. The source does not specify shoulder height, so this is an assumption that it refers to the withers.

traits.lifespan_y.note: ADW Lifespan/Longevity: 'On average, blue wildebeest live for 20 years in the wild' (status: wild 20 years). Last resort: NC. Wikipedia gives an average captive lifespan of 20 years (not used) and says the wild lifespan is debatable. Captive maximum 24.3 years not used. Only NC source for this field; no permissive source gives a wild average.

traits.diet.note: Wikipedia: 'herbivore, feeding primarily on short grasses'. Whole diet assigned to graze; no browse share is described in the checked sources. Judgement.

traits.social.note: Structure: Group. Wikipedia: rest in groups 'of a few to thousands' and herds in loose aggregations. group_size [2, 1000]: lower bound is 'a few' and upper bound rounded from 'thousands' (judgement).

traits.activity_pattern.note: Wikipedia: 'mostly active during the morning and the late afternoon, with the hottest hours of the day being spent in rest'. Diurnal is the nearest pattern in the schema.

traits.defense.note: Wikipedia: 'extremely agile and wary animals ... run at speeds up to 80 km/h'. Flee is the authored defence type.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement: 'extremely wary' per Wikipedia, rated 0.8 on the 0..1 scale. Authored value.

habitat.use.note: Wikipedia: 'short-grass plains bordering bush-covered acacia savannas'. Ground stratum only; no fossorial or arboreal use.

habitat.resources.note: Graze: Wikipedia 'herbivore, feeding primarily on short grasses'. Water: authored. Wildebeest must drink regularly; the checked permissive text did not quantify this, so the 0.5 weight is authored judgement.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Authored judgement: Avoider. No checked source describes urban tolerance for this taxon; the value follows the species' open-grassland habitat and wariness. Review before relying on it.

seasonal.strategy.note: ActiveYearRound: no dormancy is described. Wikipedia describes the mating season as tied to the end of the rainy season; the record does not model migration, which the Serengeti populations show but ZA populations were not checked for.

seasonal.phases.note: Mating: Wikipedia 'The mating season, which lasts for about 3 weeks, coincides with the end of the rainy season'. No month window for ZA is given in the checked sources, so the phase spans the year (01-01 to 12-31). Not a month-accurate calendar.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Juvenile: Wikipedia 'The calf remains with its mother for 8 months' (240 days). The scale is authored.

vocalizations.note: Bellow: Wikipedia describes territorial males 'rolling and bellowing' and 'the sound "ga-noo" being produced'. Description paraphrased; no frequency or recording.

look.note: Authored judgement: Wikipedia colour and horn description (slate or bluish-grey, horns in both sexes, dark tail) used for palette and parts. Not measured.

behavior.note: Shared program fsm-ground-forager-v1, rest window set to the diurnal values documented in the program (-90 to -6 degrees). Grazing is by walking and fleeing is by galloping. Herding and territoriality are not modelled, and midday rest is not representable with this rest window.
